Use case: stylized-concept. Square waist-up character profile of ONE original adult male Woodman of Wilderland for The One Ring. Use the latest attached book illustration as the style and costume reference only, not the group composition. Match the approved warm brown character portraits: fine muted reddish umber pen and pencil contours, expressive moderate detail, visible directional hatching and crosshatching, small rich brown shadows and broad pale ivory paper highlights.
Subject: a lean strong forest dweller in his late thirties, long narrow weathered face, prominent straight nose, short practical beard, shoulder-length hair, alert steady eyes and a quietly determined expression. A plain fur-trimmed cloth cap, simple heavy linen tunic with a small geometric embroidered collar and cuffs, weatherworn shoulder cape fastened with a simple round brooch, leather strap and practical belt pouch. Modest layered woodland clothing, patched in places. One hand holds the wooden haft of a plain forestry axe upright beside his shoulder, axe head visible near upper shoulder and kept within frame; a useful tool and means of protection. Human proportions, wiry rather than the massive Beorning silhouette. No ornate armor, royal finery or magical effects.
Three-quarter view with clear centered face and margin above head for profile cropping. Include torso and natural hand. Model face with selective fine contours and clusters of hatch strokes beneath brow, beside nose and under jaw. Hair and beard in locks with light paper gaps. Cloth fold hatching follows form, small dark pockets beneath overlapping cape and collar. Traditional book illustration with slightly stylized anatomy, intermediate between simplistic outlines and realistic shaded portrait. Very light cream paper background, faint sparse sketch hatching behind shoulders fading to blank. No scenery, lettering, border, watermark, photographic actor likeness, skin pores, smooth gray graphite shading, full color fills or thick cartoon outlines. One character only. Square 1:1 intended 640x640 WebP profile asset.
